All six optional null arguments omit and retain server defaults; empty strings and integer zero are supplied. Allowed filename characters default to A-Z and 0-9, extension to empty, random count to 100 (documented minimum 1), relative path to .well-known/pki-validation relative to the DOMAIN DOCUMENT ROOT, max redirects to null (minimum 0), and the user-agent default can change. Zero max redirects means no limit on redirect returns; a supplied N yields N+1 redirect records so excess failures are visible. No client defaults or new integer minimum/range guards are sent.

Allowed filename characters are a nonempty sequential list<string> serialized as repeated literal dcv_file_allowed_characters fields under OpenAPI query form/explode defaults. Null omits; empty/nonsequential/nonstring lists reject after metadata reset before I/O. String items, including empty or multi-character values, remain exact without one-character/charset checks. Serialization is source/default-derived and offline, not server-observed.

Results preserve input order for positional domain association; no top-row domain field is pinned. Optional failure_reason is string|null, redirects is a possibly-empty list and redirects_count is int. Unknown fields survive only inside those opaque nodes; known objects retain existing filtering.
